crossRefs.note: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys…
and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

translations.web: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy.
translations.bsb: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But look, it is now dry and moldy.
translations.kjv: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
translations.asv: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and is become mouldy:
